}}'''Gamel Loune''' is a [[Seanchan]] Banner-General from [[Dalenshar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Gamel Loune}}
== Appearance ==
He is tall and lean. He is missing the top of his right ear and has a slash of white there amongst his black curls. There is white flecks through his hair.

== Activities ==
He is visited in camp by [[Furyk Karede]], who asks him about a series of attacks that have hit the Seanchan forces in [[Altara]].
